decision.reason: [ev-0ea9d499ebef] is only a one-line changelog entry under "Other work" that says the on-deployed notification trigger was "stabilized" and points to PR #21333. It does not say what the trigger's condition or behaviour was before or after, so the subject identity, change type, before/after values, who is exposed and what happens if the operator does nothing all remain unknown. We need the PR diff or description, or the notification trigger catalog/docs, to show what changed in the on-deployed trigger definition.
